data.title: Coal tar + Salicylic acid
data.summary: VI Keratolytics & emollients · Combination: tar (antiproliferative, antipruritic) + salicylic acid (keratolytic)
data.body:
_Topicals · VI Keratolytics & emollients_

**Class:** Combination: tar (antiproliferative, antipruritic) + salicylic acid (keratolytic)

## Mechanism of action
- Coal tar activates the aryl hydrocarbon receptor → normalises keratinocyte differentiation, reduces proliferation (antimitotic), anti-inflammatory, antipruritic; also photosensitises (UVA)
- Salicylic acid removes scale and helps tar penetrate

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Chronic plaque psoriasis (body and scalp), palmoplantar psoriasis
- Seborrhoeic dermatitis and dandruff (shampoo), lichen simplex chronicus, chronic eczema
- Goeckerman regimen: crude coal tar followed by UVB

## Dose & formulations
- Ointment/lotion: apply at night, wash off in the morning; shampoo 2–3 times weekly
- Crude coal tar 1–5% or liquor carbonis detergens (LCD) 5–20%

## Adverse effects
- Odour, staining of skin, hair and clothes
- Tar folliculitis (tar acne), irritation, contact dermatitis
- Phototoxicity ('tar smarts' — burning on sun exposure)
- Carcinogenicity in occupational exposure; risk from therapeutic use is not proven

## Contraindications
- Acute, pustular or erythrodermic psoriasis; infected or broken skin
- Face, flexures, genitals (relative); pregnancy (relative)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid (theoretical carcinogen/mutagen).

## Viva points
- Tar = AhR ligand
- Goeckerman regimen: tar + UVB
- Tar folliculitis and 'tar smarts'

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.57 (tar) and ch.55; Khopkar ch.28. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
